summary: SSH-specific inventory variables: ansible_ssh_private_key_file, ansible_ssh_common_args (appended to ssh/scp/sftp, good for ProxyCommand), per-tool extra args, ansible_ssh_pipelining, and ansible_ssh_executable.
questions: How do I set a ProxyCommand for one group of hosts?
How do I use a different SSH key per host?
How do I enable SSH pipelining for a specific host?
How do I make Ansible use a different ssh binary?

answer_card.title: SSH connection variables
answer_card.answer_md:
- `ansible_ssh_private_key_file`: key file to use (when you have several keys and no agent).
- `ansible_ssh_common_args`: appended to `ssh`, `scp` and `sftp`; good for a `ProxyCommand` on a host or group.
- `ansible_sftp_extra_args`, `ansible_scp_extra_args`, `ansible_ssh_extra_args`: appended to that tool only.
- `ansible_ssh_pipelining`: overrides `pipelining` in ansible.cfg.
- `ansible_ssh_executable` (2.2+): use a non-system `ssh`; overrides `ssh_executable`.
